Aadhaar Authentication Mandatory for LPG Subsidy from October 1

Starting October 1, Aadhaar authentication will be mandatory for consumers to receive LPG subsidy. This rule applies to consumers in Uttar Pradesh, where thousands in Sambhal district have not yet completed the verification process, causing concern. The change requires Aadhaar biometric authentication for subsidized gas cylinders.
